name: Crear pedido domicilio con peso y transferencia

planSteps.description: Navigate to the home page at https://stargo-zeta.vercel.app
Click on 'Nuevo pedido' or navigate to /nuevo-pedido
Verify the page title shows 'Hacer un pedido' and the service type selection step 0 is visible
Click on the 'Domicilio normal' option in step 0
Verify that 'Domicilio normal' is selected (highlighted) and the form shows origin and destination fields
Select a barrio de origen by clicking the origin search input and typing 'Centro'
Select a barrio de destino by clicking the destination search input and typing 'Norte'
Enter a direction for origin like 'Calle 10 # 15-20'
Enter a direction for destination like 'Carrera 15 # 20-30'
In the 'Detalles del pedido' step, enter '25' in the peso (kg) field
Enter '150000' in the transferencia monto field
Verify that the price summary section shows a tarifa base and a recargo for peso (should be $2,000 for 25kg)
Verify that the price summary shows a recargo for transferencia (should be $2,000 for $150,000)
Enter a phone number '3001234567' in the celular field
Verify that either a success confirmation appears or validation errors are shown for missing fields
